alerts: 6 units are at the COMPRESSOR limit: at the return they receive their evaporator would transfer more than the machine can lift, so the capacity is held at the 110.3 kW gross the selection itself was taken at, at 37.6 degC outdoor air. A warmer day lowers it further; this study holds the outdoor air fixed.

3 units are at full duty and cannot make the 22.0 degC the case asks for: at the return they receive their coil delivers 26.8 degC with the compressor duty wide open. The run was solved with each unit delivering what its coil makes -- 22.00 to 26.73 degC across the units, 22.54 degC mixed -- so the temperatures here are that plant's own. The supply temperature is a result of this study -- what this alert says is that the plant has no reserve left at this load.

checks.name: return_path
checks.detail: the path from the containment to the fan intake is adiabatic, so these have to agree: the aisles pass 30.2 degC through the ceiling and the units draw 30.3 degC (0.08 K apart); the air crossing the ceiling spans 26.0 to 43.6 degC, which is the room being uneven; the path holds

checks.name: rack_resistance
checks.detail: the field drops 95.6 Pa across the rows where the rack curve at 385,000 m3/h asks for 104.1 Pa (92%) (rows 91.4 to 100.8 Pa) -- 5 of 171 positions carry no load; blanked, they resist like the rest, so the row is still one resistance and only the heat is missing

checks.name: floor_resistance
checks.detail: the field drops 4.25 Pa across the 238 floor plates where their K at 385,000 m3/h asks for 3.12 Pa; the air reaches it 1.4 times harder than the rated face velocity assumes, so its own K asks 4.29 Pa of this field (99%); they run at 1.25 m/s on the face

checks.name: fan_capacity
checks.detail: the room outside the cabinets costs the most loaded unit (fan8) 30.5 Pa -- 126.1 Pa of loop less the 95.6 Pa the cabinets' own fans carry -- and the unit's datasheet offers 50 Pa at 27,500 m3/h per unit (61%)

checks.name: coil_closure
checks.detail: every unit delivers the air its coil makes at the return it receives (0.04 K apart at worst, on fan2)

checks.name: settled
checks.detail: the stations moved at most 0.01 K since the previous sample (settled below 0.25 K)

checks.name: ashrae_inlet
checks.detail: warmest rack inlet 27.3 degC at the top of B01 -- above recommended (18.0-27.0 degC), still allowable for class A1; 4 of 171 racks above recommended

checks.name: plausible_velocity
checks.detail: peak 4.07 m/s against a plausible 17.68 m/s (peak air 53.6 degC)
